sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-assisted software engineering is the clearest signal today: code review, agent workflows, research automation, and agent-oriented source control all appear near the top. Local-first AI is also prominent, with a pure-C MoE runtime and a fully local voice studio among the largest daily gainers.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

sections.title: JustVugg/colibri
sections.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦

sections.title: ever-co/ever-gauzy
sections.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co

sections.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
sections.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

sections.title: melgarafael/DeskcommCRM
sections.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.

sections.title: pacifio/atlas
sections.description: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic software engineering, local and efficient AI, integration layers and MCP, with TypeScript leading the language count and Rust second.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The snapshot is shifting from standalone model demos toward operational AI systems: review pipelines, local runtimes, voice production, research agents, CRM automation, and agent-aware version control.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's leaderboard favors applied AI infrastructure over another general-purpose model release. The strongest projects reduce deployment cost or add agents to work people already do.
